Human beings are born learners.

Learning begins as soon as the newborn enters our fascinating new world and continues until death ends the learning process.

The road to learning may bring joy and fulfillment but it may also be potholed with confusion and hard work.

Before answering the question  what is learning?, it may be helpful to define what learning is NOT.

Reflex�is a behavior that is not learned.�It is a simple, automatic response involving a part of the body.�A reflex action does not require previous learning or practice.

For example, reflex actions include: babies sucking, curling and uncurling their fingers, people putting out their hands to break the impact of a fall, and gagging when something unpleasant feeling or tasting hits the back of our mouths.
